anomalies.observed: On the 'NAVC Peripherals' sheet the magnetometer U8 (IIS2MDCTR) has its SCL/SPC (pin 4) and SDA/SDI/SDO (pin 5) tied to the nets I2C4_SCL_NAVC / I2C4_SDA_NAVC. These two nets appear nowhere else in the drawing: they are not connected to the MCU (the corresponding I2C4 pins PF6/PF7 on NAVC1 carry no-connect 'x' markers), and they have no pull-up resistors (the NAVC I2C pull-up block R28-R31 only pulls up I2C1_* and I2C2_*). Every other NAVC I2C device (U5 BMI088, U6 TMP100, U7 MPRLS, U9 EEPROM) is instead wired to I2C1_SCL_NAVC / I2C1_SDA_NAVC, which is pulled up and connected to the MCU.
anomalies.expected: The magnetometer should share an MCU-driven, pulled-up I2C bus (the I2C1_* bus used by all the other NAVC sensors) so it can be addressed at 0x1E, as the specification's component table requires ('Magnetometer | ST IIS2MDCTR, I2C addr 0x1E').

anomalies.impact: The magnetometer's I2C lines are left floating (no master, no pull-ups), so the IIS2MDCTR cannot be read. The board loses all magnetometer/heading data, degrading the Kalman-filter state estimation the design depends on, even though the part is populated and powered.

parsed.summary: The power, FCC/NAVC MCU, PWM, flash, EEPROM and current-sense sections match the specification (the barometer RESET/EOC swap is the documented V1 bug, not an anomaly). The one drawing-supported deviation is that the magnetometer U8 is wired to I2C4_* nets that are not connected to the MCU and not pulled up, while every other NAVC sensor sits on the working I2C1 bus, leaving the magnetometer non-functional.
